review_views.label: 全体構図
review_views.evidence: Dv4 and the formal Dv5 raw output were compared at full 1536x1024 extent.
review_views.notes: The composition is recognizable, but the broad mountain hierarchy remains absent and the entire raster was regenerated.

review_views.label: 原寸100%
review_views.evidence: North-east and south-east mountain fields were inspected at native scale.
review_views.notes: Both fields remain dominated by nearly uniform small symbols instead of readable massifs and saddles.

review_views.label: 200%・400%拡大
review_views.evidence: Native comparison crops under tmp/map-qa-d-v5-raw were inspected at 200% and 400%.
review_views.notes: Rocks, trees, roads, ground hatches, coastlines, and paper texture were redrawn or shifted by roughly one to two pixels.

review_views.label: 中央・四隅・四辺の9領域
review_views.evidence: The complete image was scanned as nine regions.
review_views.notes: Global regeneration affects water, islands, forest, city, fields, coast, and the eastern terrain.

review_views.label: 制御図との半透明重ね合わせ
review_views.evidence: The polygon-only generation mask and final road-safe transfer mask were compared with the raw output.
review_views.notes: No conspicuous hard mask outline appears, but almost every pixel outside the generation mask changes.

review_views.label: 親ズーム画像との比較
review_views.notes: Raw Dv5 is not parent-continuous; the deterministic transfer correctly refused publication.

review_views.label: 四方向の隣接合成
review_views.evidence: Outer areas and both target boundaries were inspected.
review_views.notes: There is no single hard seam, but whole-image drift prevents canonical seam continuity.

review_views.label: ベクターラベル・道路・POI重畳
review_views.evidence: Road and symbol positions were compared with Dv4.
review_views.notes: Road edges and small symbols are visibly recomposed, so exact vector alignment is not acceptable.

review_views.label: Leafletデスクトップ表示
review_views.notes: Not staged; no candidate artifact was published.

review_views.label: Leafletモバイル表示
review_views.notes: Not staged; no candidate artifact was published.

immediate_failures.label: 海岸線・河川・主要道路・城壁の移動
immediate_failures.evidence: 1,572,560 of 1,572,864 pixels differ from Dv4; 1,034,592 pixels outside the permission mask change.

immediate_failures.label: 必須地点の欠落
immediate_failures.evidence: Band-pass Q90-Q10 is only 2 levels north-east and 1 level south-east, below the required 3.5; broad hierarchy is not readable.

immediate_failures.label: 正典外の主要都市・施設
immediate_failures.evidence: No new major settlement or facility is recognizable.

immediate_failures.label: AI生成文字・記号
immediate_failures.evidence: No label or long pseudo-writing chain was found, although existing symbols were regenerated.

immediate_failures.label: 目視できる継ぎ目
immediate_failures.evidence: No single straight mask edge or halo dominates the raw image.

immediate_failures.label: 現代物・透かし・署名
immediate_failures.evidence: No modern object, watermark, logo, or signature appears.

immediate_failures.label: 遠近法化・縮尺の急変
immediate_failures.evidence: The raw image remains broadly top-down.

immediate_failures.label: 建物・樹木・岩の不自然な反復
immediate_failures.evidence: Dense symbols remain repetitive but do not form a new dominant repeated chain.

scores.label: 正典・地形形状との一致
scores.notes: Macro composition is recognizable, but exact geometry and almost every pixel drift.

scores.label: 親子ズームの連続性
scores.notes: The raw raster is not pixel-continuous with Dv4.

scores.label: 隣接画像の継ぎ目
scores.notes: No hard local seam, but global drift makes it unusable.

scores.label: 画風・色・線密度
scores.notes: The broad palette is similar while linework is recomposed.

scores.label: 縮尺相応の情報量
scores.notes: Fine symbols remain, but macro relief information is missing.

scores.label: 生成破綻・反復模様
scores.notes: Whole-image regeneration violates the locked-detail contract.

scores.label: ベクター重畳時の可読性
scores.notes: Roads remain visible but are no longer exact.

summary: Formal Candidate D v5 is rejected. It redraws nearly the whole map yet produces too little low-frequency mountain signal. The deterministic transfer safely published no candidate, mask, field, or report.
required_changes: Change the generation input representation only: generate a standalone featureless luminance delta plate and interpret its region-centered luminance without subtracting Dv4, while preserving all final masks and safety gates.
